core_categories: Pharmaceutical Wholesale; Medical Logistics; Pharmacy Services; Medical Devices; Self-Care Products
specialty_focus: Brocacef is a major Dutch healthcare and pharmaceutical supply company, acting as a link between drug manufacturers and health groups such as pharmacies, hospitals, and clinics. It specializes in the distribution of medicines, including sensitive products requiring strict temperature control, and offers medical logistics and pharmacy services. While it distributes medical devices as part of its product range, it is primarily a pharmaceutical wholesaler and logistics provider, not a wearable-device specialist.
